summary: Frontend-only end-to-end regression on Expo web preview at 375x667. Verified light theme visibility across Setup, Toss, Series-settings, Rules, and Active screens; confirmed Strict Queen Rule (queen-eligible-toggle appears when queen-toggle ON, queen-void-note shown when eligibility OFF, hidden when ON); confirmed Strict Queen scoring math (board 1: A=+8 with eligible ON; board 2: A=+5 with eligible OFF, history shows 'No queen bonus', total 13); confirmed sound-toggle icon flips and muted playback does not crash board completion; confirmed Unlimited eyebrow now reads 'BOARD 01/02 · UNLIMITED' (previous 'OF 00' regression fixed); confirmed AsyncStorage hydration after page reload keeps user in Live match.
critical_code_review_comments: index.tsx is a single 84-line file with a huge inline component; while functional, splitting the presentation components (Setup/Toss/Active/Score/Due/History/Rule) into separate files would improve maintainability. Non-blocking.
Object.assign on styles inside the component body (line 24) runs on every render; consider hoisting or removing the merge to prevent redundant work. Non-blocking.

chime.play() is called on every board completion but the audio element is a single shared player; if a board is completed while chime is still playing, the seekTo(0)+play() pattern is fine, but consider chime.pause() before seekTo for absolute safety on web.
seed_data_creation: None (localStorage cleared before each key phase to ensure a clean setup screen).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All requested features (Strict Queen Rule UI + scoring, Sound Feedback safety, Light theme visibility, Unlimited header, AsyncStorage hydration, end-to-end match flow) are verified working.
